pages.title: A warm drink · 1/3
paragraphs: It is lunchtime at a busy burger place in Houston. Fran sits at a table with a tray. She opens the box and looks at her burger. It is not the one she asked for. Her drink is warm too. She walks back to the counter with a polite smile.
“Next! What can I get for you?” says Jake. “Excuse me, my order is wrong.” says Fran. “I’m sorry. What is wrong?” says Jake.
